summary.text: Adam Holmes is a Republican state representative from Ohio who has represented District 97 since February 2019 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A retired U.S. Marine Corps colonel, he is chief executive of a Zanesville contracting company and chairs the House Energy Committee.

paragraphs.text: Adam Holmes is the CEO of Frueh Enterprises, a mechanical and industrial contracting company in Zanesville, Ohio.
Before that, he served in the U.S. Marine Corps for 31 years and retired as a colonel in 2016.
He holds a B.S. in political science from the United States Naval Academy and an M.S. in global leadership from the University of San Diego.
Holmes assumed office in the Ohio House on February 6, 2019.
In the 2025–2026 session he chairs the Energy Committee and sits on the Natural Resources, Veterans and Military Development, and Technology and Innovation committees.
Earlier, he chaired the Joint Medicaid Oversight Committee in 2023–2024 and was vice chair of the House Health Committee in 2021–2022.
He advanced from the May 5, 2026 Republican primary and faces Libertarian Tim Godwin and independent Kristine Geis in the general election.
